title: Shared Is Not Enough: Predictor Width and Factor Readability Under Masked Latent Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.32562v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Masked latent prediction methods such as I-JEPA aim to learn predictable features, but what determines which information they retain is less clear. We built a simulator in which every factor behind an image is known, so a probe can measure how readable each factor remains after training. We trained small encoders (0.7M parameters) with I-JEPA, SimCLR and BYOL on the same pairs of views and probed a factor that both views share. I-JEPA had a predictor with half the encoder's width and depth, the proportions it uses for ViT-B. Its median score was about 40% of SimCLR's. Widening the predictor to the encoder's width reversed this ordering at every training seed, against both other methods. We release the simulator and the trained models.

translated_title: 共享并不足够：掩码潜在预测下的预测器宽度与因子可读性
translated_abstract: 诸如I-JEPA之类的掩码潜在预测方法旨在学习可预测的特征，但决定它们保留哪些信息的因素尚不清楚。我们构建了一个模拟器，其中图像背后的每个因子都是已知的，因此探针可以测量训练后每个因子仍然保持的可读性。我们使用I-JEPA、SimCLR和BYOL在相同的视图对上训练了小型编码器（0.7M参数），并探测了两个视图共享的一个因子。I-JEPA的预测器具有编码器一半的宽度和深度，这是它在ViT-B中使用的比例。其中位数得分约为SimCLR的40%。将预测器加宽到编码器的宽度后，在每个训练种子上都逆转了这一排序，超过了其他两种方法。我们发布了该模拟器和训练好的模型。
tldr: 该论文通过构建所有潜在因子已知的模拟器，发现I-JEPA因使用宽度仅为编码器一半的预测器而导致共享因子的可读性大幅下降（中位数得分仅为SimCLR的40%），而将预测器加宽到编码器同等宽度后可在所有训练种子上逆转这一劣势。
en_tdlr: Using a simulator where all latent factors behind images are known, this paper shows that I-JEPA's narrow predictor (half the encoder's width) causes shared factors to lose readability (median score ~40% of SimCLR's), and widening the predictor to full encoder width reverses this deficit across all training seeds.
